persona: busy recruiter or engineer, first visit, quick to lose interest
scoreScale: 0-10 (10 = would happily keep scrolling / perfect pacing / games impossible to miss)

screens.why: Hero lands: name, one-line pitch, glowing wave. But ~9 s of Hogwarts flight before the name, then ~8 s of static hero.
Porthole opens on the ghost ship: quick and striking. Then an 8 s hold on one picture with a one-line caption.
'A research journal in four acts' plus a five-item contents list: orients me and hints there is play. Small grey type.
'A builder of quantitative systems.' plus short bio and four traits: finally says who and what. Dense small text, but fits one screen.
'How the methodology was earned': harbour picture plus a route mini-map. A story with a visual device.
Step 2 (Pine Script) while the picture dissolves to a storm: the image keeps changing.
'They failed out-of-sample': an honest failure story over a teal wave. A real hook for a quant reader.
Step 4, 'a validation methodology of my own', on a sunset sea. Tail is ~2 s of near-empty sea (Kraken's Storm).
Wave tears open onto the 3 Idiots chalkboard; 'Treat every backtest as guilty until proven innocent' is a great line.
Mid-transition: dim pen photo and a tiny drone glyph; no heading in the 2 s stop, nothing to read.
'Led by what survived scrutiny.' is a clear rigor promise. But six identical dwell frames and a lot of empty dark.
Seven-part validation gauntlet beside a chalkboard bar chart: real substance with a visual.
Flagship 'Quantitative Trading Research': what I came for. Very small text, lower-left half of the screen empty dark.
Blue blueprint board plus hand-circled results (3 survivors, +1.19, 470): concrete numbers.
'What is a machine?' classroom interlude breaks the project read; another film plate, seen it.
Second flagship, 'Automated Strategy Research Pipeline': blueprint, heading, new photo.
Stats row (3,000+ / 25% / 10-15) and drone-on-lawn photo. Bullets are dense but the numbers scan.
'See the thesis, not just read it.': a chart with a scenario toggle invites a click.
Equity curve draws itself as I scroll, then the drone photo rises in.
'What I can actually do.' under the drone photo with a Take off chip: the skills part, human and concrete.
Systems map: near-empty dark screen, faint small text and a blue board. Dead area.
'The kill-list' with a Dead Eye pill: ideas that failed, credible and unusual. Reuses the pen picture from a minute ago.
A list of strategy names in tiny type, row after row; the bracket glyph hopping between rows is unexplained.
More list rows, then a dark tail before the next card; nothing new.
'Three films and a game' card explains the concept and the egg hunt; four act buttons. Four seconds on a mostly dark card.
Black Pearl again (third sighting after the hero horizon and the Act I porthole): seen it.
Yellow scooter at Pangong Lake, 'Aal izz well.': fresh bright image, one quote, quick.
Red tree and 'Be loyal to what matters.': strong colour shift, short.
Hogwarts Express viaduct and a Dumbledore line: new picture, quick.
Dark tail, then the next act heading and a light streak arrive; something is coming.
Golden-hour grade comes up on the landscape: the most cinematic moment of the page.
Same sunset held ~8 s for a two-line 'Discipline, service, and a trained eye.' Slow, nothing new.
'Discipline, in three arenas' with a hand-drawn route map on tan paper: charming and human.
Horse silhouette plus two small text columns (family legacy, showing up): dense personal detail, off-topic for hiring.
'What's in the satchel': camera, sketchbook, drone, running shoes drawn as an inventory; looks hoverable.
WANTED poster for Aryan Sharma: witty, memorable, then the paper lifts in.
Cream journal 'Thinking in public, soon.': lovely palette flip but nothing to read yet.
Draft entry titles and doodles, again no content; placeholder.
Paper dissolves into a pine skyline at night: a great transition.
'In their words.' teacher quotes over a campfire: social proof, readable.
More quote text, then a campfire image wipe: transitional and repetitive.
Great Hall full-bleed with a candle iris and 'The Light': stunning, readable caption.
The 'Map of the Principles' parchment rises from the bottom: cinematic.
'A small philosophy of work.' on the Marauder's Map with a footprint trail: clear heading, cute.
Principles 2-4 in the same parchment card layout: repeated, seen it.
Parchment ends and contact lands: 'Let's talk research, markets, or building systems that are honest about their limits' plus an email button. The payoff I would act on.
Contact scrolls away; credits start in tiny type: end of useful content.
Credits and fan-tribute fine print, small and static: I would stop.
Final near-black frame with 'Mischief managed.': a fine ending, nothing left to scroll.

acts.act: Opening and hero (Hogwarts flight, sea, name)
acts.feel: Ceremonial and gorgeous, but ~9 s before the name and ~8 s of static hero: about 20 s before any information.

acts.act: Act I card and contents (ghost ship, 'A research journal in four acts')
acts.feel: Porthole reveal is brisk for a second, then the ship sits for ~8 s on a one-line caption.
The least cinematic part: a text block held 6-8 s; at 1024 it spills into a second text wall.
Best rhythm on the page: a step and a new picture every 2-4 s, with a story that has stakes.

acts.act: Act II card, work intro and gauntlet (3 Idiots chalkboard)
acts.feel: Chalkboard reveal is brisk; then a text-only hold of up to 6 s.
Dense small text and big empty dark; the chart screens liven it up. The part I came for is the heaviest.
Drone photo and heading are lively; the map beneath is sparse.
Strong hook, then a table of rows that repeats.

acts.act: Intermission and film plates ('Three films and a game')
acts.feel: A new picture every ~3 s; the quickest, most watchable run, though it recaps films already shown twice.

acts.act: Act III card and Beyond (golden hour, three arenas, satchel, WANTED)
acts.feel: Sunrise grade is cinematic; then 6-8 s holds on one image and dense side columns, then a quick poster.
Palette flip is great; the pages are 'soon' placeholders, so the 5-6 s feel empty. The skyline dissolve is brisk.
Readable proof, then a transitional wipe.

acts.act: Act IV card and Principles (Great Hall, Marauder's Map)
acts.feel: Great Hall is stunning; the parchment then repeats one card layout for 12-14 s with 4 s static holds.
Contact lands well; credits fade to fine print and black. Natural end.

findings.finding: About 9 s of Hogwarts flight and sea before the name lands (name appears in #5, ~0:09), then the hero sits ~8-10 s with only waves moving. First real information (About) arrives ~0:34 (1440) / ~0:30 (1024). A quick-to-bounce recruiter is gone before the site says what it is.

The most hiring-relevant part (flagship projects) is the least legible and least visual: small grey body and mono text, big empty dark areas (1440 #43: lower-left half blank), bullet walls (1440 #52-53, 1024 #50-52), while pure mood plates elsewhere get big pictures.
Contact shows 'Resume, coming soon' under the email button. A recruiter's most likely action has a placeholder. Also contact is reached only after ~4 minutes.
'Play' stays on screen while the flight is already running, so it is unclear whether I started it or should click; the skip links in the top-right corner are tiny grey mono.
Hero identity line ('Self-taught high-school quant, Landon School, class of 2027') and both buttons are tiny mono text; the one line that says who he is is the least visible thing on the screen.
Dead areas: 1440 #63 is a near-black screen with faint small text and a blue board; the Kraken's Storm transition is 2-3 s of mostly empty teal sea with a caption.

The 2 s stop lands on an in-between frame: dim pen photo, a tiny drone glyph, no heading. 'The Workshop' title card flashes over the chalkboard as it leaves (1440 #33-#34, 1024 #32), so the best caption appears when the picture is already going.
Static dwells: several stops show 4-6 s of identical frames (1440 #37-#39 are six seconds of the same text screen). Nothing living moves while I stop, whereas the hero waves still move.
'Thinking in public, soon.' plus draft entry titles with no content: beautiful cream page, nothing to read, 5-6 s of it.

Repetition: the Black Pearl turns up three times (hero horizon, Act I porthole, film plate); the pen picture twice (1440 #34-#39 and #64-#66); the four films three times (act cards, intermission card, film plates). 'What is a machine?' interrupts the projects.
Marauder's Map principles: one card layout repeated 4-5 times with 4 s static holds (1024 #108-#109 identical frames). Charming once, 'seen it' by the third.

The only sentence that tells me there is a game ('12 easter eggs hide on this page... two buttons start games') is a few lines of tiny body copy; the nav counter stays 0/12 all 4 minutes and nothing pulses or hints.

About 4 minutes at 250 px/s; roughly 40% of the runtime is hiring-relevant (About, Journey, Work, Contact). The middle (films, Beyond, Writing, Voices, Principles) is another ~40% and is personality, not evidence.
'The Crossing' appears as a large grey title over the ship for under a second and vanishes; reads as a flicker or ghost text rather than a title card.
At the cream-to-night dissolve the pine skyline shows as a noisy barcode-like strip at the top of the frame, which reads as a glitch before it resolves.
A small blue bracket glyph (three circles) hops between kill-list rows; it sits on the edge of row text at 1440 (#68) and its meaning is unexplained.
The compass medallion appears to sit on top of the text columns in the About traits block (around the gap between 'Process over outcome' and 'Intellectual honesty').
Credits and fan-tribute disclaimer are ~9-10 px grey on black: unreadable at scroll speed (fine as fine print).
